title: Shipping Middelburgsche Commercie Compagnie in the Eighteenth Century
descriptions: This dataset consists of several datafiles containing information on voyages by Dutch slave ships from Middelburg to Africa and Surinam, Curaçao, Berbice or other Caribbean destinations and back, covering the period 1721-1760.
